Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
Sponsor: Barfoot
Analyst: JT Mathis
Date: 01/24/2022
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 98 as introduced provides for the continuance of the Alabama Real Estate Commission until October 1, 2023 pursuant to the Alabama Sunset Law. This bill will not otherwise affect state or local funding.
Steve Livingston, Chairperson
Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development
